title: Anchorage button
description: Square-shouldered buttons with a 4px radius: a cobalt fill that deepens on hover, a solid inverse (white on dark) for coloured bands, and a 2px outline that fills lilac on hover. Medium-weight Inter labels; 0.3s ease transitions.
notes: inverse is meant for coloured bands (the CTA gradient)
name: anchorage-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: cobalt fill · inverse: text-coloured fill (white on dark), for coloured bands · outline: 2px frame that fills lilac on hover

props.name: type
props.description: the button's type when it isn't a link (e.g. "submit" inside a form)
